notes.title: The Longest Road on Earth is Now Available!
notes.content:
We know you've been waiting for a long time (♫ a long time now ♫) for the launch of The Longest Road on Earth. The wait is over! Our game is now live on Steam, iOS, and Android!

[previewyoutube=rvewjxqPH7M;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't thank our supporters enough, from the early days of Kickstarter to everyone that has been adding it to their Steam wishlist over the last few months to everyone who buys it today and onward! It's not been easy to develop a game about the connections that people share in a time that we're all so isolated, but we hope that spending time in the lives of our everyday characters will help you heal - it's certainly done that for us.

For anyone that wants to pick up the soundtrack after the fact (though, we highly recommend grabbing it in the bundle ahead of time to save yourself some time -wink- ) we are happy to announce our partnership with Sony Music Soundtracks who are going to be distributing the album! You can head to their page [b][url=http://soundtracks.lnk.to/longestroadonearth]here[/url][/b].

Our soundtrack is now on Spotify! Add songs to your playlist today: https://open.spotify.com/album/6XdUnhMh6kcTqCf4WWgl2i?si=3B01f7GmR8eRLmHzA_aUcg 

The Longest Road on Earth is a part of the Save and Sound Festival on Steam, starting today! This festival focuses on the music of videogames, and we've got a great video that will be playing on Raw Fury's feature block starting around 11:30am PT/2:30pm ET/8:30pm CET.  Visit [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url] for the full schedule!

Check out some really cool videos from us and others from the Raw Fury family:

[list]
[*]   The Longest Road on Earth - The developers at Brainwash Gang take viewers through the last chapter of their game, chat about making a game that focuses on music, and include an acoustic version of "The Shape of Clouds"
[*]   Atomicrops - Joonas Turner takes us through the found-object music creation process he used to create the Atomicrops soundtrack
[*]   Star Renegades - Composer Steve London breaks down what it takes to score a rebellion
[*]   Kathy Rain - Daniel Kobylarz discusses how music heightens the game experience and his return to the Kathy Rain universe 5 years after its initial release
[*]   Call of the Sea - Composer, Eduardo dela Iglesia talks about the inspiration behind Call of the Sea and conducts an orchestra in a live performance of the soundtrack
[/list]

Thanks for taking this walk with us <3

- Brainwash Gang/TLR Games

notes.title: Moose talk!
notes.content:
Chapter 4 of The Longest Road on Earth features why has quickly turned into most people’s favorite character — a young moose. He’s precocious and full of energy! He reminds everyone of what it’s like to be a kid and the magical world you can create in your mind.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39246165/628a9b699bd43cd25f2549992a69a40b50e541ce.gif[/img]

Some moose facts:
[list]
[*] Moose can run up to 35 miles per hour… we’re pretty sure our little moose can double that if we give him a handful of candy.
[*] Female moose only have one or two babies (calves) in their lives. It would explain why our little guy seems to be an only child!
[*] Male moose are the only ones who grow those giant antlers they’re known for… our little guy has a long way to go to a full set!
[*] Moose are adorable as if that weren’t apparent already ;)
[/list]

Brainwash Gang
TLR Games

notes.title: The Longest Road on Earth Song Highlight
notes.content:
Today I wanted to dive into the song we used to announce our launch date, very aptly named “The Longest Road on Earth”.  It’s like when a music album is named after one of the songs!

[previewyoutube=Zht3BGKp5Xg;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]THE LONGEST ROAD ON EARTH[/b]

I don't know where to start
There's a lot of things
I'd like to talk to you about
Time's still flying by
It's a race where no one wins
At the finish line
I have written many songs
Some will stay with me forever and
others will just go
A new fear now lives with me
Wrinkles around eyes I love means
One day, they won't be here
Won't be here

I still don't know who I am
Or who I wanna be when I get older
Even tho I'm older now
I don't know what I'm here for
But I found out no one knows
Everyone just goes with the flow

Uhhhhhhhhhhh

I'm still learning how to love
I thought I got it all figured out
but turns out I was wrong
And my sister had a beautiful son
Everyday I think about the one that was mine but then
Never was
Never was

I still don't know who I am
Or who I want to be when I get older
Even though I'm older now
I don't know what I'm here for
But I found out no one knows
Everyone just goes with the flow

Uhhhhhhhhhhh

I don't know where to start
There's a lot of things 
that I can talk to you about
I'm still scared of the dark
I'm really bad at making calls
without my family I'm lost
and I often doubt my words cause
I still don't know who I am[/i]



I thought it would be nice to write a song as if I was talking to an old friend or my past self and that is how this song began. The lyrics talk about things that have impacted my life in some way. To tighten that up the chorus encompasses how I’ve felt the past years navigating how to be an adult and discovering what that means to me, as opposed to the preconceived ideas I had about it. 

My favorite part is where I talk about my nephew. I asked my sister to send me an audio of him saying: Hola titi! That’s how he calls me and I just love to have his little voice be part of this.

Then it was Edu’s idea to have the rest of the team singing with me to finish the song, which is very special because making all this music by myself can get a bit lonely. I loved sharing this experience with the rest of the team and I hope this song can mean something to you, so you will be part of it as well. 

- Beicoli
Brainwash Gang
